text:
Ivy: Heads-up from partner: they want a concise marketplace gating plan covering H100/H200, MI300, B200 and a small non-binding Gaudi roadmap note. Need matrix + embargo timing by EOD Thu.
Marco: Ill take the matrix draft. Need perf confirmation and SI window. Arun can you give perf ETA?
Arun: Perf runs queued in staging. Expected: MI300 Wed AM, H200 Wed PM, H100 Thu AM, B200 Thu PM. B200 needs an extra thermal pass.
Tess: SI team can do a dry-run Fri-Sat. Post the exact runtime tags and kernel so partners can validate.
Marco: Staging tags (temporary):
redwood/runtime:1.1.0-mi300-rc
redwood/runtime:1.1.0-h200-rc
redwood/runtime:1.1.0-h100-rc
redwood/runtime:1.1.0-b200-rc
redwood/runtime:1.1.0-gaudi-community
kernel: 5.15.100 + nvidia-542-rc
Arun: Adding B200 note: include power/thermal profile row and a flag if capped perf >10% below baseline.
Ivy: Partner also wants a short embargo handshake for comms. Draft suggestion: 72h partner review after matrix share, 48h final signoff, 24-48h canary validation before public listing. Keep phrasing non-committal.
Marco: Canary plan: dedicated pool (3% traffic) -> broad canary (15%) -> GA. Route initial canary to Dedicated/us-west-2 only; exclude Hosted for first 48h.
Tess: One-line partner runbook: `docker pull redwood/runtime:1.1.0-mi300-rc && sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime && ./scripts/check_gpu_quick.sh`
Ivy: Ops-bot, please create an internal calendar for the partner handshake review Fri 09:30 PST.
ops-bot: Created event "Marketplace HW Handshake: H100/H200/MI300/B200" Fri 09:30-10:15 PST. Invited: Ivy, Marco, Tess, Arun.
Arun: Ill upload perf logs to gs://redwood-staging/gpu-compat/3812345678/ when done.
Tess: Adding SI escalation snippet to matrix: if ECC or OOM errors -> page runtime-oncall and open Jira RED-2345. If firmware mismatch -> pause canary and escalate to drivers lead.
Marco: Action recap: Marco -> matrix + embargo blurb (owner) due Thu EOD. Arun -> perf logs + routing policy by Thu night. Tess -> SI dry-run scheduling + runbook by Fri morning. Ivy -> partner comms and non-binding Gaudi note.
Ivy: Thanks. Keep partner-facing text tight. Post final matrix link here when shared.
Marco: Will do. :thumbsup:
